I have a new role open on my team: Staff Engineer – GenAI. We’re building an enterprise-grade Agentic AI platform that helps teams build, integrate, and operationalize GenAI solutions quickly, with minimal friction. The challenge is making it work in the real world: enterprise architecture, security/compliance, governance, and operational excellence. If you’ve been the “high-leverage IC” who builds platforms other teams depend on—APIs, orchestration, standards, dev experience—this is worth a look. https://jobs.republicservices.com/us/en/job/R-174485/Staff-E...

Location: Remote in the US with a preference for people Arizona (but not mandatory)

Comp Range: $132,600- $182,250 DOE.

Sponsorship: Not at this time
